new_news.headline: Waste to Energy Application Portal Open Through May 31, 2026
new_news.summary: DOE opens application portal for waste-to-energy and biogas projects through May 31, 2026. Includes updated Biogas Opportunities Roadmap extending beyond wastewater to animal husbandry and other feedstocks; early opportunities in disposal-cost feedstocks including FOG and organic wastes.

new_news.headline: EPA Draft Guidance on FOG Treatment: Chemical and Biological Methods Do Not Constitute 'Removal' Under Clean Water Act
new_news.summary: Coverage of upcoming FOG compliance shifts driven by EPA draft guidance and municipal enforcement trends, including IoT-enabled grease interceptors and digital monitoring requirements expected by 2027. The article discusses how municipalities are piloting smart monitoring technology that transmits fill levels and pump failures to sewer authorities.

new_news.headline: Barrel Energy Inc. Reports Q1 2026 10-Q: Going Concern Disclosure
new_news.summary: Barrel Energy (BRLL) filed Q1 2026 10-Q showing revenue of $42.4K and net loss of $6.2K versus prior year net income. Cash declined sharply to $4.2K and management disclosed 'substantial doubt' about continuing as going concern without external funding.

new_news.headline: St. Louis Restaurant Openings, Closings and Coming Soons
new_news.summary: St. Louis dining scene recorded 3 closings and 16 openings in early May 2026. Includes new locations from chains like Little Lager and Sweetie Pie's 2nd Act, plus numerous independent venues opening across the metro area.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Reports Q1 2026 Results with Strong EBITDA Growth; Provides Investor Day Guidance
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q1 2026 revenue of $1,550.82M and net income of $134.31M, swinging to profitability. At an Investor Day, management outlined a three-year cash generation target of $4-6 billion from 2027-2030 for debt reduction and growth investments.

new_news.headline: Vacuum Truck Market Experiences Notable Evolution Driven by Environmental Regulations and Efficiency Innovations
new_news.summary: Vacuum truck market report highlights electric engine segment rapidly gaining traction alongside established ICE dominance. Innovations include enhanced suction capabilities, improved fuel efficiency, and advanced filtration systems. North America accounts for 45% of global vacuum truck market share.

new_news.headline: Waste360 Reports Q1 2026 Solid Waste Industry Business Results with Strong Pricing
new_news.summary: Waste360's May 2026 Business Report recaps Q1 2026 financial results from publicly traded solid waste companies. The report notes strong pricing performance across core services and improved margin expansion, though the article is broader solid waste industry focused rather than specifically on FOG/grease/septic.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Renewable Diesel Momentum: How Durable Is It?
new_news.summary: In Q1 2026, DGD reported robust performance with 272.4 million gallons sold at an average EBITDA of $1.11 per gallon. As renewable diesel demand increases competition for feedstocks, Darling's Feed segment is expected to benefit from stronger fat pricing trends throughout 2026. Regulatory clarity on the RVO has fundamentally shifted the operating environment for Diamond Green Diesel, providing a clear path forward.

new_news.headline: Barrel Energy Inc. Achieves Full SEC Reporting Status
new_news.summary: Barrel Energy (OTC: BRLL) announced transition to fully reporting SEC company status, citing it as a milestone for increasing stock marketability and visibility to support engagement with investors and strategic partners.

new_news.headline: 5 Biggest Restaurants Closing Locations in May – And the Next Wave is Already Underway
new_news.summary: Major chain closures continuing through May 2026: Wendy's closing 300-350 locations under Project Fresh, Papa John's closing ~300 restaurants, Red Robin closing up to 20, Denny's closing 150, Red Lobster closing 100+. Closures cite underperformance and cost pressures.

new_news.headline: 2026 Refuse Truck Market Reaches First Year of Electric-Diesel Cost Parity on Waste Routes
new_news.summary: 2026 marks first year where electric and CNG refuse trucks compete directly with diesel on cost and range. EPA NOx limits tightening 90%, California Advanced Clean Fleets rule driving electrification; regenerative braking enables ~30% energy recovery at stop-and-go collection cycles.

new_news.headline: Clean Harbors Reports Q1 2026 Results, Raises Full-Year 2026 Guidance
new_news.summary: Clean Harbors achieved record Q1 2026 revenue of $1.46B with EPS of $1.19 beating estimates. Adjusted EBITDA increased 6% to $247.9M with margin expansion to 17%. Company raised full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $1.24-1.30B.
